title: Wrapping up
html:
This week you read a charity evaluation, followed a cost-effectiveness model and built a rough estimate of your own.

Everything this week relied on measurable outcomes, strong evidence and short causal chains. That suits direct health programmes. It suits advocacy, policy change and research much less, because their results are slow and hard to count.

Next week covers those cases: how to make a reasoned estimate when the evidence is thin and the stakes are high.
